info.title: WildNetwork open API
info.description: Read access to WildNetwork's live map and effort-corrected measures, and authenticated push of WDX detection events. Responses mix sources, including BirdWeather detections shown with BirdWeather's agreement for display only: use the API to view and explore, and the citable open data releases (https://wildnetwork.arunrajiah.com/data) for analysis and redistribution. No key is needed to read; please keep to about one request per second.
